name: walletfreak
description: Plan trips, choose cards and redemptions from your wallet, and explore itineraries in a private local viewer.

interface.shortDescription: One travel toolkit. Your own local trip dashboard.
interface.longDescription: Plan trips, choose cards and redemptions from your wallet, and explore itineraries in a private local viewer.
defaultPrompt: Plan a trip with flexible dates and show my local trip board.
Open my personal wallet to enter my cards and loyalty balances.
Choose the best card or points redemption from my wallet using current quotes and offers.
Use dashboard-builder to arrange my wallet, spending metrics and itinerary in a local dashboard.
